Veterans Benefits: Tennessee has no individual income tax on wages or most retirement income. Qualifying disabled veterans and surviving spouses may receive state-funded property-tax relief; veterans with a 100% permanent-and-total service-connected disability and former prisoners of war are exempt from the county motor-vehicle privilege tax. Tennessee also provides veteran identification and license-plate options, recreational and hunting/fishing benefits, burial and cemetery services, education and employment assistance, and state veterans homes.

Description: Tullahoma is a southern Middle Tennessee city with an unusually strong aerospace and defense-engineering presence for its size. Arnold Air Force Base and the Arnold Engineering Development Complex sit immediately outside the city, while the University of Tennessee Space Institute reinforces the local aviation and engineering workforce. The area combines no Tennessee individual income tax, a nearby VA clinic, moderate home values, and access to lakes, waterfalls, and outdoor recreation, with hot humid summers and recurring severe-thunderstorm and tornado exposure.
